name: Hedgewars
description: macOS Sparkle DSA-signed vs bundled dsa_pub.pem (no Win/Linux updater).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the retrieved Hedgewars checkout, the macOS Sparkle bundle configuration uses the HTTPS Hedgewars appcast and names the bundled dsa_pub.pem as SUPublicDSAKeyFile. The Qt front end invokes the macOS Sparkle checker only when its auto-update preference is enabled. Other platform packaging and Sparkle framework enforcement remain outside this review.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; released artifacts, framework enforcement, and complete Windows/Linux packaging paths were not independently audited.

original_evidence.text: | Hedgewars | https://github.com/hedgewars/hw (GitHub mirror of canonical https://hg.hedgewars.org/hedgewars/) | Sparkle (macOS only) | Y on macOS only (`AutoUpdater`/`SparkleAutoUpdater` wraps Apple's Sparkle framework); no Windows/Linux self-updater found in source (no WinSparkle or equivalent present) | Partial — `checkForUpdatesInBackground` runs silently on startup, but Sparkle's stock UI still prompts the user to confirm install (not silent auto-install) | Y (Sparkle downloads and installs the update package once user accepts prompt) | https (`SUFeedURL` = `https://www.hedgewars.org/download/appcast.xml`) | Y — Sparkle DSA-signed appcast/enclosure scheme configured | Y (Sparkle framework verifies the downloaded update's DSA signature against the bundled public key before allowing install — standard Sparkle behavior; verification code itself lives in the (out-of-repo) Sparkle.framework, not in this repo) | Bundled public key file `share/dsa_pub.pem`, referenced via `SUPublicDSAKeyFile` | frontend-qt6/hwform.cpp:202 (`updater->checkForUpdates();`); frontend-qt6/util/platform/SparkleAutoUpdater.mm:32-54 (`[SUUpdater sharedUpdater]`, `checkForUpdatesInBackground`, `checkForUpdates:NULL`); share/Info.plist.in:50-53 (`SUPublicDSAKeyFile` → `dsa_pub.pem`, `SUFeedURL` → `https://www.hedgewars.org/download/appcast.xml`); share/dsa_pub.pem (key file present in repo) |
